I would aim for internal consistency. Please replace all angle brakets with |reg| tags. l. 4, I would only regularize the ὑμεῖν. l. 8, indent.

Submit - Text of DDbDP 47589 (P.Kynopolites 5) entered from final word copy, collated against PDF. Ed prints at lin.8 κδ with supralinear strokes over both digits. App for same prints "κδ corr. ex κβ," in each case with supralinear strokes over the second digit only. Digital image suggests stroke over the second digit only. I have encoded the text accordingly.
